Two types declare `RunOnce`, both named `Runner` but in different packages, and only the s3presign one is actually called anywhere.

- `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43`) — yes, invoked from production code — called by `Server.startBackgroundRunners` at `server/server.go:163`, and internally by its own `Runner.Run` loop at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`
- `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) — no — no caller anywhere in the repo (production or test)

A couple of details worth knowing. The `memopayload` package is used in production, but only through its free function `RebuildMemoPayload`, which `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls at lines 108 and 447; `memopayload.NewRunner` is never called, so the `Runner` type and its `RunOnce` method are unreferenced. On the s3presign side, `startBackgroundRunners` calls `RunOnce` once synchronously at startup and then launches `Run`, which calls `RunOnce` every 12 hours.

I searched the whole repository case-insensitively for `runonce`, so this covers the frontend under `web/` as well — there are no JavaScript or TypeScript declarations by that name.
